subject: Action required: unusual sign-in detected
body:
Dear user,

We detected an unusual sign-in attempt on your Northwind Mail account. To keep your mailbox active, you must verify your identity immediately. Click the link below and enter your username and password within 24 hours or access will be restricted.

Northwind Mail Security Team

subject: Final notice: your account will be suspended
body:
Hello,

Your Contoso Bank online banking account has been flagged for suspicious activity and will be permanently suspended today. Failure to confirm your account details will result in legal action and loss of funds. Confirm your details now to avoid suspension.

Contoso Bank Compliance Department

subject: Overdue invoice #INV-20931 - payment required
body:
Hi,

Our records show invoice #INV-20931 for $4,870.00 is now 30 days overdue. Please arrange payment today by wire transfer to our new bank account to avoid late fees and service interruption. Updated banking details are in the secure document linked below.

Regards,
Accounts Receivable
Fabrikam Supplies

subject: Quick favor
body:
Hi, are you at your desk? I'm stuck in back-to-back meetings and need you to handle something urgently. Please buy five $200 Apple gift cards for a client today, scratch off the backs, and email me photos of the codes. Keep this confidential for now, I'll reimburse you this afternoon.

Sent from my phone
Daniel Reyes, Regional Director

subject: Your package could not be delivered
body: SwiftParcel: We attempted to deliver your package today but no one was available. Your parcel is being held at our depot. A redelivery fee of $1.99 is required. Schedule redelivery and pay the fee within 48 hours or your package will be returned to the sender.

subject: Greenfield Library October newsletter
body:
Hello readers,

This month the Greenfield Community Library is hosting an author talk on Thursday evening, a children's story hour every Saturday morning, and a beginner's workshop on spreadsheets. Our new fiction shelf now includes twelve recently released novels. Thank you for being part of our community.

The Greenfield Library Team

subject: Reminder: project sync tomorrow at 10:00
body:
Hi team,

Just a reminder that our weekly project sync is tomorrow at 10:00 in Room 3B. We'll review the sprint board, go over the testing plan, and agree on next week's priorities. Please add any agenda items to the shared doc before the meeting.

Thanks,
Priya

subject: Reset your Tailspin Learning password
body:
Hi Sam,

We received a request to reset the password for your Tailspin Learning account. If you made this request, use the link below to choose a new password. The link expires in 60 minutes. If you didn't request a reset, you can ignore this email and your password will stay the same.

Tailspin Learning Support

subject: Q3 budget spreadsheet?
body:
